messages.subject: For Maurici Lucena | Airports, public infrastructure and international stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Aena Press Office,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Maurici Lucena, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Aena's global airport network operates at the intersection of public infrastructure, aviation regulation, communities and international growth. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities in a complex operating environment.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and public-infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Aena's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Aena.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
